name: libgit2
license: GPL-2.0-only with the libgit2 linking exception

projectPatches.reason: Treat GIT_STATIC declarations as ordinary extern declarations so MSVC does not copy libgit2's public API into the package DLL export table.

Disable automatic WinHTTP authentication replay for anonymous public Source acquisition and preserve authentication-scheme errors as GIT_EAUTH; the shim refuses credential callbacks and delegates third-party authentication to system Git.
Clear freed global setting pointers at shutdown so subsequent runtime owners can reapply the fixed User-Agent without a double free.

Provide a private non-exported thread-error cleanup helper, declared in src/util/errors.h, so runtime owners can release their TLS allocation before a different thread shuts down the shared runtime and deletes the POSIX TLS key.

artifactPolicy.linkage: static libgit2 inside one package-owned dynamic Native Asset

updateProcedure: Select an upstream libgit2 release and record its immutable tag and commit.
Download the commit archive, verify its SHA-256, replace native/third_party/libgit2 as one source subtree, and reapply every recorded project patch.
Review the license, changelog, vulnerability notices, CMake switches, generated feature header, and project shim compatibility.
Regenerate private ffigen bindings and run clean-generation checks.
Run native, Flutter host, C ABI, sanitizer, crash-recovery, and release-artifact gates on macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64, and Linux x64.
Update this lock file and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the same commit.
